tokens/ uses static sRGB values so scripts/build.ts can emit RGB triplets for host-contract.css, tokens-dark-first.css, scoped [data-theme] subtrees, and standalone SVG/PDF exports without shifting pixels across 27 apps.

A shipped global reset would break 27 mixed-stack apps: font-synthesis: none breaks italics because css/fonts.css ships upright faces only; max(16px, 1rem) breaks the dense desktop scale; * { min-width: 0 } risks collapsing flex children; :root text-wrap: pretty shifts lines in editors.
Block logical Tailwind utilities (mbs-, inset-bs-) require Tailwind 4.2+; our fleet spans Tailwind v3.4 through v4.3 and UnoCSS with no RTL product.
Viewport-fluid clamp()/pow() scales conflict with our desktop-only 4px spacing grid (R-spacing-grid, R-control-height); keep for editorial/marketing pages only.
overflow: clip does not establish a scroll container (flex items keep min-width: auto, and clip + text-overflow: ellipsis is untested in Firefox). Restrict to pure non-ellipsis clipping boxes.

Adopted negative rules from good-css: never add * { text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic }, text-rendering: optimizeLegibility, or resets setting display: contents / shared grid-area: 1 / 1 on every element.
